source.doc_type: Reviewed condensed consolidated and separate interim financial statements 3Q2025 (Thai)

notes: Quarterly (9 months to 30 September 2025 = year to date). First IFRS 17 interim year (2567 comparatives restated). Scanned; read locally, pages located by their headings (file page numbers). Reviewed, not audited (Deloitte). Thousand Baht. The SCI has consolidated and separate columns; the separate columns are used (owner decision): three months p.6, nine months p.8. Its tax line is an expense printed positive (profit before tax - tax = net profit), turned negative. Note 21.1 nine months is printed once for the consolidated and separate statements (p.98 revenue and expenses; columns GMM 7.1 / PAA 7.2 / VFA 7.3 / total); expenses are printed positive (turned negative). CSM roll-forward = GMM (p.59, closing p.60) + VFA (p.74), CSM columns; new business = GMM p.62 + VFA p.76 totals. Each summed item records the GMM page. Future-service change = change in estimates + experience adjustment. VFA accretion is nil. Other expense = other finance costs + other operating expenses. The three-month profit or loss is the SCI for the three months to 30 September 2568 (p.6).
